capturePlan.batch: Complete the seven R407 cases already registered by Root
capturePlan.perCase: Full battle video to actual resolution, up to 60 s/180 MB; keep actual trace, per-case battle_art receipt and video marker joined by pixels/OCR. Do not treat markerVisible node flag as pixel proof.
capturePlan.reason: B_R04_B was the R391 composite-validator false positive with unreviewed raw visual sequence; all six R05 cases lacked R391 event traces and have only forced-state samples/selected older individual clips.

capturePlan.batch: If R407 closes the seven but residual trace gaps remain, use the same R407 app and exact existing challenge routes for only the 16 prior actors whose R377/R391 battle traces lack execute and/or recover.
capturePlan.perCase: Single naturally played battle, full to resolution, 60 s / 180 MB hard cap. Record states only when passive controller snapshot shows them; no forced poses. If encounter ends before execute/recover, label that state unobserved/conditional, not an asset defect.
capturePlan.estimatedAdditionalBytes: ~2.1 GB at measured R391 rate (20 clips/434,640,399 bytes/~8s each); hard cap ~2.88 GB for 16 clips. Re-check available capacity and split if required.
capturePlan.reason: These are the trace gaps, not all30 recaptures. Old R391 videos are only 7.90–8.07s (20 clips, 434.6MB), covering the opening segment; exact pixel marker OCR/join was not established.

capturePlan.batch: Use the R407 B_R04_B area attack clip (already in priority 1) to check all four party hit reactions.
capturePlan.acceptance: A real area-damage event must be visible and marker-joined to the four actor hit poses; if fewer are actually targeted/visible, do not infer coverage from target-row counters. The existing R377 full-party trace renders all four across six states but its 8s video visibly samples AIRA hit only.

capturePlan.batch: Environment/VFX residual, after the enemy sequence: capture five region representative clips rather than one per ID.
capturePlan.acceptance: In each region, one continuous playable view with the corresponding ambient background and at least one actually triggered FX; preserve event/asset ID and actual pixel timing. This is only a first pass: three ENV subgroups per region (24 indexed refs) and 48/56 FX refs are not all proven by one sample. Current R407 seven-case battles cover R04/R05 only; existing R377/R391 videos include R01–R04 scenes but lack reviewed per-ID ENV/FX joins.

limitations: R391 is explicitly SYNTHETIC_CHALLENGE_TECHNICAL_ONLY; R377 uses a QA fixture. Neither demonstrates ordinary campaign occurrence.

R377 enemy videos and all R391 videos have no verified event-to-video join. R377 one full-party clip has an S03 marker joining only seven sampled frames. R391 marker reports visible in scene rows but videoJoin requires OCR and remains unestablished.
R391 result is CAPTURE_FAILED_RAW_PRESERVED: 19 cases require visual review; case20 B_R04_B trace reached battle-finished but runner rejected composite root texture; R05 six were never launched.

R366 visual samples are forced state requests, not ordinary event-driven timing. They show no gross clipping in reviewed windows; they cannot establish transition, timing, hit causality, naturalness, or death/resolve duration.
